content.text:
**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

The renewal mechanics meet our preferred position on every parameter:

- **Renewal term** (§ 8.2): successive **twelve-month** periods — no multi-year auto-renewal.
- **Opt-out window** (§ 8.2): **30 days'** written notice, exercisable by Customer only (Vendor has no reciprocal non-renewal right to use as leverage).
- **Reminder** (§ 8.2): Vendor must remind Customer **60 days** before renewal, and failure to do so extends Customer's opt-out deadline to 30 days after the reminder is actually received — this makes the short window genuinely workable rather than a trap.
- **Price uplift** (§ 8.3): capped at the **lesser of CPI and 3%**, with 90 days' notice, and **no increase applies to prepaid periods**.
- **§ 8.1** sets a fixed three-year initial term (not an automatic multi-year renewal) and expressly preserves Order Forms past expiry without extending the non-renewal window.
